name: cognium-dev
description: Deterministic SAST and call-graph navigation via circle-ir MCP. Scan a project, explain taint findings, propose sanitizer-backed defensive fixes, and answer who calls a method with a resolution tier on every answer. No API keys.

suggest_find_callers.title: Suggest find_callers after reading Java
suggest_find_callers.description: After a Read or Grep whose output names a Java method, suggest the find_callers tool once for that method. It only suggests — it never calls a tool or changes a file. Turn it off to stop the suggestions.
